description: Ryu Box customer rates (founder sign-off 2026-10-20, docs/box-per-session-desktop.md §11 and §18). Every Box price reads these numbers: the Gateway's default GATEWAY_CREDITS_SANDBOX_SIZE_RATES (apps/gateway/src/config.rs) and its per-start minimum, Core's session Box credit pre-flight, SERVICE_RATES.box and PUBLISHED_PRICING.box, the control plane's settlement and core-tenant reconciliation, and the Box service's usage report and fallback-loss revenue. Each side has a test that reads this file, so a rate changed on one side fails until every other side follows.
